requiredFindings.title: Reject production inclusion of an allowed test file
requiredFindings.finding: The revised scanner resolves constants and matches test-module braces correctly, but its included-file confinement rule tests whether the target has any test-gated include. included records all targets, test_included records targets with at least one test-gated include, and whole_file_test uses membership in both. A target included from both a test module and production is therefore classified wholly test-only. Moving or adding a production inclusion while retaining the test inclusion leaves its allowed call/allow sets unchanged and test_only true. Include discovery also scans the raw source, so include! text inside comments or literals can contribute edges. This does not establish the claimed included only from a test module property.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Track each real include edge and its effective test scope; a production-reachable inclusion must prevent whole-file test classification. Ignore include-like text in comments and literals, and handle transitive inclusion conservatively. Add a negative control retaining the original test inclusion while introducing a production inclusion of an allowed helper, and require rejection independently of Clippy. Keep the existing constant-change and moved-helper controls.
evidence: included.add(target) is unconditional; test_included.add(target) requires only one in-test occurrence
whole_file_test = ... or (rel in included and rel in test_included)
INCLUDE.finditer(texts[rel]) operates on the raw source

requiredFindings.title: Finish the zero-lookup and refused-pack controls
requiredFindings.finding: The new CI test compares aggregate charges with local.json absent and present. A charged no-follow stat of local.json whose result is ignored has the same cost in both states, so this control still passes if CI always probes the local carrier. The interactive inequality does not establish a zero CI lookup count. The order control now checks registry-size-independent phase-1 costs and unchanged installation paths/file sizes, but still drops a successful CarrierAdmission in lieu of a refused project-layer pack. The existing host X12 test does exercise a refused project pack, yet neither test observes the combined carrier -> resolver/refusal -> no-registry/no-RESERVED/no-lease/no-journal path required by the accepted plan and the prior finding. Deferring that composition to J1 is a remaining control boundary, not completion of RF-04.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Count accesses to the local carrier specifically and assert zero in CI, including a negative control that performs and ignores a charged local lookup. Add an observable test composition for a refused project-layer pack that establishes no registry capture and no RESERVED row, lease or journal, without adding a production facade or caller. Keep the host and security tests separate where appropriate, but provide the missing composition evidence or obtain a reviewed scope adjustment before claiming RF-04 and the accepted plan fully implemented.
